native_fusion_readback.note: Native archive exported and reopened. Other assembly references are retained but hidden for local inspection. This evidence applies to the export fingerprints below; rerunning the builder regenerates the report and requires a fresh native readback.

R1.2 rear and R0.8 front exposed inner pad corners; R0.5 upper rear external corners.
Removed added 0.2mm top lips without trimming the inherited print or upper rear attachment.
Removed 0.05-0.15mm front membrane remnants; planar Y11.8 interface setback.
Consolidated three tiny core connector cutouts and fragile separating webs into one 3.74mm-wide by1.1294mm-high clearance pocket, ending at Y16.
Removed the inherited 0.05mm overhanging membrane along the top of the fan recess; retained the adjacent solid shelf and insert seats.

inherited_clearance_evidence.basis: Verified R27 is a subtractive subset of hash-matched R26. All other assembly solids are reused unchanged; subtraction cannot increase swept rigid intersection volume.
inherited_clearance_evidence.note: Not a new continuous-motion or structural qualification.

limitations: Existing original rack bed collision and probe cable entry issue remain.
Required clearance to a separate core/backplate is not a gap that may be arbitrarily bridged.
Cool-side guide/socket fit and temperature, structural behavior, fan cooling and insert pullout are unqualified.
Outer-entry heatsets require physical pullout, material and tightening qualification.
Core-clearance pocket and tapered web stiffness require print/fit review; this is not acceptance by visual appearance alone.
